Cargo upload and npm tarball choices were checked against [Cargo’s publish protocol](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/registry-web-api.html#publish) and [npm publish documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-publish/).
